programs.name: International Master EUROSUD South European Studies

academic.text: Hold an official undergraduate degree worth at least 180 ECTS credits (or equivalent) in Humanities, Social Sciences, or a closely related field.
academic.quote: You must hold an official undergraduate degree worth at least 180 ECTS credits (or equivalent) in: Humanities (e.g. Languages, Communication, Journalism, History, Literature, Geography), Social Sciences (e.g. Political Science, International Relations, Sociology, Law, Public Administration, European Studies, Anthropology, Area Studies, Economics, Business), or a closely related field.

prerequisites.text: English: minimum level B2, preferred C1 (CEFR), with official proof required.

prerequisites.text: French B2 level required for Track 1 (UAM-AMU), with a TCF/DELF/DALF level B2 certificate, except for nationals of countries where French is the official language.

academic.quote: Estar en disposición en el momento de solicitar la admisión del correspondiente título o certificación oficial de licenciados/as o graduados/as en Psicología, Sociología, Antropología, Pedagogía, Psicopedagogía, Trabajo Social, Educación Social y titulaciones afines del ámbito de las ciencias humanas, sociales y educativas.
